'''"Ace" Lorle''' was the owner of [[Clubs]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Byrne City]] on the planet [[Demophon]]. He had a distinctive appearance, a small man with a fat face, hooded eyes, and a [[Neutronium/Legends|neutronium]] front tooth. He presented himself as an information broker, but anyone who approached him to make a deal was turned over to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], for which Lorle got a finder's fee. [[Enid Vahr]] went to Lorle to escape [[Demophon]] before the [[Demophon supernova]], but discovered Lorle's Imperial connections and escaped capture.<ref name="BE" />
